landing.heroTitle: Governing Civic Action to Turn Community Needs into Verifiable Impact
landing.heroSubtitle: NEXUS DZ connects 8 accredited associations, 20 field volunteers, and impact verifiers across Constantine across a complete lifecycle: from need identification to audited proof.
landing.pillarsSubtitle: Switch roles at any time to demonstrate the full 12-step impact workflow
landing.pillar1Desc: Review and approve local associations across Constantine's 7 main communes.
landing.pillar2Desc: Create community initiatives, process volunteer applications, and log attendance.
landing.pillar3Desc: Upload field photos and reports with GPS metadata stored directly in localStorage.
landing.pillar4Desc: Approve pending evidence as an Impact Verifier and watch dashboard KPIs update live.
landing.step1: 1. Login as Super Admin & review/approve Constantine associations
landing.step2: 2. Switch to Organization Admin & launch a community initiative
landing.step3: 3. Switch to Volunteer to apply, then assign a task & log attendance
landing.step4: 4. Upload field evidence & approve as Impact Verifier to update KPIs

about.title: About NEXUS DZ
about.subtitle: Civic-Tech & Social Impact Management platform tailored for Constantine, Algeria.
about.missionBody: NEXUS DZ bridges the gap between grassroots community action and measurable institutional reporting by providing a verifiable system of record for associations, volunteers, and civic partners.
about.scopeBody: Covers Constantine Center, El Khroub, Ali Mendjeli, Ain Smara, Hamma Bouziane, Didouche Mourad, and Zighoud Youcef.
about.gov1: Role-based separation between Super Admin, Organization Admin, Volunteer, and Verifier.
about.gov2: End-to-end traceability across tasks, attendance logs, and GPS-tagged field evidence.
about.gov3: Impact KPIs and volunteer hours update automatically upon verifier approval.
